r0098: FOR THESE REASONS, THE COURT UNANIMOUSLY
r0099: 1.  Holds that there has been a violation of Article 1 of Protocol No. 1 to the Convention;
r0100: 2.  Holds that there has been a violation of Article 6 § 1 of the Convention;
r0102: a)  that the respondent State is to pay the applicant, within three months from the date on which the judgment becomes final according to Article 44 § 2 of the Convention, the following sums:
r0103: -  ITL 330,000 (three hundred and thirty thousand Italian lire) for pecuniary damage;
r0104: -  ITL 15,000,000 (fifteen million Italian lire) for non-pecuniary damage;
r0105: -  ITL 5,800,000 (five million eight hundred thousand Italian lire) for costs and expenses;
r0106: b)  that simple interest at an annual rate of 2.5% shall be payable on those sums from the expiry of the above-mentioned three months until settlement;
r0107: 4.  Dismisses the remainder of the applicant’s claim for just satisfaction.
